exposure: genetic findings (chromosomal microarray, next-generation sequencing for pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants, CNVs, point mutations)
cohort: This study included 77 children with Level 3 Autism Spectrum Disorder from a Sicilian pediatric cohort.
finding: Genetic predisposition was present in 54.5% of children with Level 3 ASD and correlated with a higher burden of prenatal, perinatal, and neonatal risk factors, including low birth weight, hyperbilirubinemia, and early neurological comorbidities.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an independent predictor of genetic positivity.
